Kingdra

Water Dragon

Johto · Generation 2

Kingdra is a Water/Dragon-type Dragon Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 152 kg. It evolves from Seadra. Its highest base stat is Attack (95), with a base stat total of 540.
